test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 20 Jun, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Fill in the blank with the most appropriate option.**

Harry stepped in, his head almost ______ the sloping ceiling, and blinked.
solution:
The correct answer is "touching."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The reason to use **"touching"** in the blank is to convey that Harry's head is almost in physical contact with the sloping ceiling.
 
• The word** "touching"** in this context emphasizes the close proximity of Harry's head to the ceiling, suggesting that there is very little space between them. (इस संदर्भ में **"touching"** शब्द हैरी के सिर की छत से निकटता पर जोर देता है, जिससे पता चलता है कि उनके बीच बहुत कम जगह है।)
 
• It adds a sense of immediacy and physical closeness to the description.
 
• The correct answer is option 2.

Correct sentence: *Harry stepped in, his head almost **touching**__ the sloping ceiling, and blinked.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• Cuddling: **to put your arms around someone and hold them in a loving way, or (of two people) to hold each other close to show love or for comfort. (किसी के चारों ओर अपनी बाहें डालना और उन्हें प्यार से पकड़ना, या (दो लोगों का) प्यार दिखाने के लिए या आराम के लिए एक-दूसरे को पास रखना)
 
• **Embracing: **to put your arms around somebody as a sign of love, happiness, etc. ((प्रेम, प्रसन्‍नता आदि से) आलिंगन करना, गले लगाना)
 
• **Grasping:** to take hold of somebody/something suddenly and firmly. (व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु को एकाएक कसकर पकड़ लेना)
